Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana

Eligibility

Available to people in the age group of 18 to 50 years having a bank account who give their consent to join and enable auto-debit.

Benefits

Risk coverage under this scheme is for Rs. 2 Lakh in case of death of the insured, due to any reason, against a premium of Rs. 436/- per annum.

Documents Required

  • Aadhaar number
  • Bank account details
  • Consent for auto-debit
